title: Cordyceps mind-controlling bullet ants

tellings.quote: Bullet ants in the Amazon eat cordyceps mushrooms, which co-opt their brains and movements and [inaudible] mind-control them onto higher ground where a fruiting body sprouts from the head of the ants.

plain: In the Amazon, bullet ants, a large stinging ant, are said to take in cordyceps, a parasitic mushroom that takes over their brains and movements. The fungus steers each ant up to higher ground, and there a mushroom stalk grows out of the ant's head. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, while talking about mushrooms as a kind of mind control.
